units.literal: In the fourth month of summer that year, Yichao submitted: "Having received the edict appointing me acting commissioner of Yan Prefecture, I have already welcomed and accepted the gracious command; but because the three armies and the common people block and detain me, I have not been allowed to proceed to my post."

units.zh: 明宗遣閣門使蘇繼彥賫詔促之。
units.en: Mingzong sent gatekeeper envoy Su Jiyan with an edict to urge him on.
units.literal: Emperor Mingzong dispatched the Gatekeeper Envoy Su Jiyan bearing an edict to urge him on.

units.zh: 五月，安從進領軍至城下，彜超不受代，從進駐軍以攻之。
units.en: In the fifth month An Congjin brought his army to the city; Yichao refused to yield; Congjin encamped and attacked.
units.literal: In the fifth month, An Congjin led his army to the foot of the city wall; Yichao would not accept replacement; Congjin encamped his army to attack him.

units.zh: 秋七月，彜超昆仲登城謂從進曰：「孤弱小鎮，不勞王師攻取，虛煩國家餉運，得之不武，為仆聞天子，乞容改圖。」
units.en: In the seventh month Yichao and his brothers mounted the wall and told Congjin: "This is a small, isolated command; it need not trouble the imperial army or state supplies — to take it by force would be unworthy; let me report to the emperor and beg leave to reconsider."
units.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, Yichao and his brothers mounted the wall and said to Congjin: "This is a lone, small command; it does not require the imperial army to take it by force, vainly troubling the state's supply transport — to gain it would be unmartial; allow me to report to the Son of Heaven and beg permission to change our plan."

units.zh: 時又四面党項部族萬餘騎，薄其糧運，而野無芻牧，關輔之人，運鬥粟束槁，動計數千，窮民泣血，無所控訴，復為蕃部殺掠，死者甚眾，明宗聞之，乃命班師。
units.en: Meanwhile more than ten thousand Tangut horsemen pressed their supply lines from all sides while the countryside offered no fodder; people of the capital region hauled grain and hay in thousands of loads; the poor wept blood with nowhere to appeal and were again killed and plundered by tribal forces; the dead were many; when Mingzong heard of this he ordered withdrawal.
units.literal: At that time moreover, on all four sides more than ten thousand Tangut tribal horsemen pressed upon their grain transport; yet in the wilds there was no fodder for grazing; the people of the capital region transported grain by the dou and bundles of hay, each movement reckoned in the thousands; the destitute wept blood with nowhere to appeal; they were again killed and plundered by the tribal forces — the dead were very many; when Emperor Mingzong heard of this, he ordered withdrawal of the army.

units.zh: 彜超亦上表謝罪，乃授彜超檢校司徒，充定難軍節度使，既而修貢如初。
units.en: Yichao also submitted a confession; he was appointed acting Minister of Education and military commissioner of the Dingnan army, and soon resumed tribute as before.
units.literal: Yichao also submitted a memorial confessing guilt; he was then appointed acting Minister of Education and military commissioner of the Dingnan army; before long he resumed tribute as before.

units.zh: 清泰二年，卒於鎮。
units.en: He died in office in the second year of Qingtai.
units.literal: In the second year of Qingtai he died in his post.

units.zh: 弟彜興襲其位。
units.en: His younger brother Yixing succeeded him.
units.literal: His younger brother Yixing succeeded to his position.

units.zh: 彜興，本名彜殷，宋受命之初，以犯廟諱故改之。
units.en: Yixing, originally named Yiyin, had his name changed at the founding of Song because it violated an imperial temple taboo.
units.literal: Yixing, original personal name Yiyin, at the beginning of Song's receiving the Mandate had his name changed because it violated a taboo of the imperial temple.

units.zh: 彜超既卒，時彜興為夏州行軍司馬，三軍推為留後，唐末帝聞之，正授定難軍節度使。
units.en: After Yichao died, Yixing was campaigning marshal of Xiazhou; the army made him acting commissioner, and the last Tang emperor formally appointed him military commissioner of the Dingnan army.
units.literal: After Yichao died, at that time Yixing was campaigning marshal of Xia Prefecture; the three armies pushed him as acting commissioner; when the Last Emperor of Tang heard of it, he formally appointed him military commissioner of the Dingnan army.

units.zh: 晉天福初，加檢校太尉、同平章事。
units.en: Early in Jin Tianfu he was made acting Grand Commandant and Tongping Zhangshi.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianfu of Jin he was added as acting Grand Commandant and Tongping Zhangshi.

units.zh: 少帝嗣位，加檢校太師。
units.en: When the Young Emperor succeeded, he was made acting Grand Preceptor.
units.literal: When the Young Emperor succeeded to the throne, he was added as acting Grand Preceptor.

units.zh: 八年秋，彜興弟綏州刺史彜敏與其黨作亂，為彜興所逐，彜敏奔延州，彜興押送到闕，骨肉二百餘口，朝延以彜興之故，縶送本道斬之。
units.en: In the autumn of the eighth year, Yixing's brother Yimin, prefect of Suizhou, rebelled with his faction; Yixing drove him out; Yimin fled to Yanzhou; Yixing escorted him to court with more than two hundred kinsmen; for Yixing's sake the court sent them back to his circuit for execution.
units.literal: In the autumn of the eighth year, Yixing's younger brother Yimin, prefect of Sui Prefecture, rebelled together with his faction; he was driven out by Yixing; Yimin fled to Yan Prefecture; Yixing escorted him to court — more than two hundred kinsmen; the court, for Yixing's sake, bound them and sent them back to his circuit for execution.

units.zh: 開運元年春，詔以彜興為契丹西南面招討使。
units.en: In the spring of the first year of Kaiyun an edict appointed Yixing pacification commissioner on the Khitan southwestern frontier.
units.literal: In the spring of the first year of Kaiyun, an edict appointed Yixing pacification commissioner of the Khitan southwestern frontier.

units.zh: 漢乾祐元年春，加兼侍中。
units.en: In the spring of the first year of Han Qianyou he was made concurrent Palace Attendant.
units.literal: In the spring of the first year of Qianyou of Han he was added as concurrent Palace Attendant.

units.zh: 是歲，李守貞叛於河中，潛使人構之，彜興為之出師，駐於延州之北境，既而聞守貞被圍，乃收軍而退。
units.en: That year Li Shouzhen rebelled at Hezhong and secretly incited Yixing, who marched out and encamped on Yanzhou's northern border; hearing Shouzhen was besieged, he withdrew.
units.literal: That year Li Shouzhen rebelled in Hezhong; he secretly sent men to incite him; Yixing marched out an army on his behalf and encamped on the northern border of Yan Prefecture; soon hearing that Shouzhen was besieged, he then withdrew his army.

units.zh: 周顯德中，累加至守太傅、兼中書令，封西平王。
units.en: During Zhou Xiande he rose to Acting Grand Tutor and concurrent Director of the Secretariat and was enfeoffed as Prince of Western Ping.
units.literal: During Xiande of Zhou he was repeatedly promoted to Acting Grand Tutor and concurrent Zhongshu Ling, and enfeoffed as Prince of Western Ping.

units.zh: 皇朝建隆元年春，制加守太尉，始改名彜興。
units.en: In the spring of the first year of Song Jianlong an ordinance made him Acting Grand Commandant and first gave him the name Yixing.
units.literal: In the spring of the first year of Jianlong of the Imperial Dynasty, by ordinance he was added as Acting Grand Commandant and first given the name Yixing.

units.zh: 乾德五年秋，卒於鎮。
units.en: He died in office in the autumn of the fifth year of Qiande.
units.literal: In the autumn of the fifth year of Qiande he died in his post.

units.zh: 制贈太師，追封夏王。
units.en: An ordinance posthumously granted him Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed him as Prince of Xia.
units.literal: By ordinance he was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as Prince of Xia.

units.zh: 子光睿繼其位，其後事具皇朝日曆。
units.en: His son Guangrui succeeded him; subsequent events are recorded in the Song court calendar.
units.literal: His son Guangrui succeeded to his position; subsequent events are fully recorded in the calendar of the Imperial Dynasty.

Read all Chinese units for omissions; English is not independent evidence. Do not re-extract names or mentions. For each item identify whose event is dated and justify each endpoint. Same mother does not imply same birth year. Later allusions are not personal activity. Research or record a blocker rather than invent precision. A report cannot approve with missing checks or unresolved research.

findings.problem: The bare genealogy 「祖鐸，父端」 identifies Li Maozhen’s grandfather and father but supplies no dated event for either man. The AD 830–873 intervals and resulting before-874 hints are unsupported personal chronology.
findings.action: Remove the unsupported interval-bearing attestations and derived active-date hints while preserving the names and family relationship.

findings.problem: 「祖君佐，鄜延節度判官」 and 「父懷遷，都押衙」 state offices only. They do not support AD 860–895 or AD 870–895 windows, nor the copied active-date hints.
findings.action: Retain the offices and kinship but remove the invented date contexts, attestations, and active-date hints unless targeted independent research supplies dated evidence.

findings.problem: The units describing Fu Zhao, Li Maozhen’s mother, and the comparison with 「細柳、大樹之威名」 contain no dated personal event. The attached AD 907–923, BC 154, and AD 23–34 chronology misstates an undated episode or retrospective allusion as activity.
findings.action: Remove the unsupported life-date attestations and active hints; retain any allusion as an undated retrospective reference rather than personal activity if the repair schema permits it.

findings.problem: The text saying Yongji held several posts, naming Acarya, and saying Congzhao died does not establish the AD 924–946, 923–936, or 923–938 spans. The end dates come from other people’s events and the spans falsely imply each subject’s activity throughout.
findings.action: Remove the unsupported interval attestations and hints; retain only independently evidenced dates tied to each named person’s own event.

findings.problem: 「思恭卒，弟思諫繼之」 establishes a death and succession but gives no year. AD 881–907 is an arbitrary Tang-wide envelope rather than a source-supported event date.
findings.action: Remove the interval-bearing attestations; keep the undated death and succession until a source-backed date can be supplied.

findings.problem: The retrospective wording 「當本朝播越之後，及先皇興復之初，爰及眇躬」 and the kinship label 「仁福之次子」 do not date a specific event for Li Renfu or his son. The AD 923–933 and AD 933 values borrow surrounding narrative chronology.
findings.action: Remove the unsupported attestation intervals and active hints; preserve the memorial’s reception context and the kinship relation separately.

findings.problem: The edict’s examples—「且如李從嚴之守岐、隴」, 「高允韜之鎮鄜、延」, 「又若王都之貪上谷，李賓之吝朔方」, and 「只陳近事」—are retrospective references. They do not prove the AD 926–933, AD 929, or AD 923–933 personal activity/death dates now recorded.
findings.action: Reclassify the passage as a dated retrospective reference to the edict’s subjects or remove the unsupported life chronology and hints; do not retain exact dates without targeted source evidence.
